title: A parsed design doc
description: What the design-doc parser makes of one Markdown file with aw-doc front matter: its front matter, its items, the refs between items, and its errors. The parser, not this schema, owns the rules that need the text or the scope: which doc kinds define which item ids, near misses from the raw line, and resolving refs. The convention is docs/conventions/design-docs.md; the spec is docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-04-sindri-pr-review-page-design.md §4.

parserVersion.description: The parser's version. A new version re-reads every doc (spec §5.3, Backfill).

frontMatter.description: The front matter as read. It holds the convention's shape unless errors names SND-LIB-010 (a bad key) or SND-LIB-019 (a near miss, which has no front matter to keep).

items.description: The doc's items in document order. Empty when a parse error is present (see allOf).

allOf.description: Without a front-matter error, the front matter is the convention's.

A doc with a parse error has no items: it is stored broken instead of vanishing. The scope errors (SND-LIB-012 shared id, SND-LIB-015 broken ref, SND-LIB-016 unknown parent or supersedes) are decided on read and keep the items.

docId.description: Lowercase letters, digits and '-', 3 to 64 characters.

fullDocRef.description: doc:<root>[/<slug>]/<doc id>: root aw (with the repo-slug), a vault name (spaces allowed), or repo:<name>.

docLink.description: A doc id in the same scope, or a full ref to a doc in another scope.

frontMatter.description: The convention's front matter (spec §4.2). Keys it doesn't name (an Obsidian note's tags, say) are kept and ignored.

aw-doc.description: The convention version; the number 1 opts the file in. The parser decides this from the raw line, not the parsed value: YAML reads 1.0 as the number 1, and aw-doc: 1.0 is a near miss (SND-LIB-019).

project.description: A Sindri project id, or linear:project/<id>.

issues.description: GitHub issue numbers as plain numbers, or Linear keys.

generated.description: The tool that wrote this file; only on generated files.

source-sha256.description: The sha256 of the generated file's source.

parent.description: The item this one belongs to: an acceptance criterion's requirement, or the section a heading sits under. Null at the top.

text.description: The item's line and the lines under it, capped at 4,000 characters.

id.description: The heading's anchor, by GitHub's slug rule.
Ph<n>, an optional lowercase letter or -<n>, no leading zeros (Ph01 is stored as Ph1).

ref.description: A link from an item (or the doc, when from is null) to an item here or in another doc.

to.description: <item id> in this doc, <doc id>#<item id> in this scope, or doc:<root>[/<slug>]/<doc id>#<item id>.

line.description: The line the error is on; null for a whole-file error (too large, blocked).
